Had a great tour of @HopeAndHelpInc in Central Florida yesterday.

Together, we will work to end the HIV/STI epidemic in our community through testing, treatment, and comprehensive education. https://t.co/ChaISjifcL

My team met with @ParentProjectMD this week to learn about their efforts in the fight against muscular dystrophy and offer our support.

We are committed to advocating for research funding, raising awareness, connecting the community, and broadening treatment options. https://t.co/0Gwo7OqPRg

Happy to see the newest facility our friends at @orlandohealth opened just 4 days ago in northwest Osceola County is already doing amazing work.

They have 11 ER treatment rooms, a helipad for rapid ambulance service, and other emergency services that are always crucial. https://t.co/ckxTpJlM4O

Yesterday, we passed the #RestoringHope for Mental Health and Well-Being Act, which includes aid for adult suicide prevention services and treatment for those with serious mental illnesses. It's time to get people the mental health care they need and remove barriers to care. https://t.co/WGTxOVHXAW

Wishing @POTUS a swift recovery from COVID-19.

We are all grateful he is only experiencing mild symptoms thanks for being fully vaccinated and boosted.

Remember to go to https://t.co/gsYkkBY0xf to find a vaccination site and stay safe.

This weekend, I attended the World AIDS Day Health Fair in Kissimmee — an educational event hosted by @HealthyFla and @lgbtcenterorl.

We must remember those we lost, continue to make progress on testing and treatment in Florida, remove the stigma, and end the epidemic. https://t.co/p1TAmHZoqy

Today is #WorldCancerDay and I am proud to reaffirm my support for cancer prevention, early detection, and quality treatment for all. 

On this day, let us #CloseTheCareGap and explore different resources for cancer prevention, honor the survivors, and mourn the lives lost. https://t.co/i8uGfLaswl

We visited @SelectM Hospital in Orlando today to speak to their medical providers and learn about their work.

They are helping critically ill patients heal and recover by developing customized treatment plans that help patients breathe, eat, walk, talk, and think again. https://t.co/Cz0DvbxgCD

In #FL9, @beepAVsolutions serves our community by transporting veterans to the VA, taking families to Nemours to receive cancer treatment, driving tourists around Lake Nona + more.

In @EnergyCommerce, we're advancing bills to ensure automated vehicles are safe + made in America! https://t.co/HSAXeoo36A
The decision to strike is never taken lightly, and it reflects the genuine concerns and aspirations of UAW workers who deserve fair treatment, equitable wages, and retirement security.

Thrilled to welcome the Florida @Teamsters to discuss workplace rights and the right to fair treatment.

Proud of them for recently voting to ratify a historic collective bargaining agreement with @UPS. #UnionStrong https://t.co/7J8jthSEN6

the VA to provide a toxic exposure screening to every veteran enrolled in VA healthcare

We are committed to combatting stigmas about HIV and increasing access to preventative medicine, testing, and treatment.
https://t.co/KHEHugrXdT
